stage1.impression: A clean, disciplined spectrum line-up on white seamless, very much in the iMac G3 / Apple product-page idiom; the horns' tinted glass glows and the colour order reads at a glance. But the speakers hover rather than stand: there is almost no contact shadow, the floor is a flat near-white with no falloff, and the cabinets read slightly milky and uniform, so the frame says 'clean render' more than 'photographed in a studio'. Grey blocks in both bottom corners are a visible set seam.

blocking_9: Each speaker visibly sits on the seamless: a soft contact shadow under every plinth, darkest at the feet (lum about 215-230 within 25 px below the base) and fading over ~0.4 m
Floor carries a gentle tonal falloff instead of a flat 248 white, while the coloured caustics under each speaker stay visible
No grey patches or seams anywhere in the seamless, corners included
The black and water-clear units hold their silhouette and edges against the white (rim highlight on their side faces)
Cabinets read as saturated tinted acrylic with depth, not as a milky veil over the internals

defects.what: Grey rectangular patch in the bottom-left corner of the floor (lum median 224, range 26 vs 248 floor) - a set edge or unlit reflection seen in the sweep
Same grey patch in the bottom-right corner, slightly blue (lum median 225)
Contact shadows nearly absent: floor 2-4 px below the bases is already 239-245; speakers look like they float
Floor is a flat 248-249 near-white with lum range 3.4: no falloff, no weight, little depth
Black unit reads as a flat dark-grey block (median 46); its edges and the horn shape are weak against the frame
Cabinet faces read milky/greyish; the tint is washed by front fill so the acrylic does not glow as strongly as the horns
Background is a flat 235-244 field with no gradient; acceptable for type but adds no depth

changes.problem: The speakers do not stand on the floor; there is effectively no contact shadow.

evidence.measured: profile y: 238.7 immediately under the base then 244-246; band [230,805,760,830] median 240.7

changes.expected: A soft grey pool under each plinth, darkest at the feet (~215-230) and back to floor white within ~60 px.

changes.problem: The back-top lamp floods the floor around the speakers to near-white, flattening it and washing out the contact shadows.

evidence.measured: lum median 248.7, range 3.4 (flat), white_out is 238 yet floor sits at 248-249

changes.expected: Floor in the foreground settles to ~238-244 with a visible gradient toward the camera; caustic tints under each unit remain.

changes.problem: Grey blocks in both lower corners break the seamless.

evidence.measured: lum median 224, p5 214, range 26 vs centre floor 248; right corner [2750,1000,2880,1200] median 225

change.setting: set.bounces[0].size_m (and set.width if the sweep edge is in view)
change.to: [18.0, 1.4] so its reflection in the 0.32-rough sweep covers the full frame width

changes.expected: Corners as light as the adjacent floor, no rectangular edge.

changes.problem: Front key fill washes the cabinets milky so the tinted acrylic glows less than the horns.

evidence.measured: green cabinet faces read greyish-green; horns saturated by comparison (blue horn b 206 vs r 62)

changes.expected: Deeper, cleaner tint in the cabinet panels with internals still legible; whites on the floor unchanged.

changes.problem: The black and water-clear units lose their edges against the white; the black one is a flat block.

evidence.measured: black cabinet lum median 46, p95 219.6, little edge definition on the right face

change.to: a reflect_only white card, size 2.0 x 1.4 m, center [5.0, -1.0, 1.0], normal [-0.95, 0.3, 0.0], giving a vertical edge highlight on the right faces

changes.expected: A thin bright edge on the right side of each cabinet, strongest on the black unit, so its silhouette reads.

changes.problem: The background is a uniform field; a gentle top-to-horizon gradient would add depth and lift the type area.

evidence.measured: lum median 239.7, range 8.9; band at y 300-340 is 243.9

changes.expected: Top of frame ~230-234 easing to ~242 at the horizon; type area still clean.

out_of_scope.request: The water-clear unit's bright white woofer ring dominates its face compared with the coloured rings
out_of_scope.why: It is a part/colour of the speaker; fixed by the card.
